urpg.addonDescription: Your life, in progress. Turn meaningful work into quests and grow a character alongside you.
urpg.addonHelp: An optional workspace overhaul with eight stats, skills, rituals and a weekly reward shop.
urpg.createCharacter: Create your character to get started.
wizardHelp: A dedicated workspace for your next chapter.
Choose your own food, water and weekly XP targets.
Here is how your new workspace works.
urpg.targetsHelp: Use targets you have chosen for yourself. Health and mana show your logged intake, reset daily, and do not change your XP. Age and weight are profile details only.
urpg.hierarchyHelp: Epic → Mission → Quest → Challenge → Action. Break a dream into steps, or start with a single action.
urpg.xpHelp: Complete an item to gain base XP × difficulty × quality, rounded down. XP advances your character, its stat and the chosen skill. Parent milestones award their own completion bonus; child XP is never counted twice.
urpg.coinsHelp: Every 10 XP earned this week unlocks 1 coin. Coins reset each Monday; lifetime XP stays with you. Refund a reward before undoing XP that paid for it.
urpg.recoveryHelp: Rest is part of progress. Debuffs are optional, with a recovery action you choose. A break never costs XP.
urpg.completeProfile: Complete your character name, workspace and daily targets.
urpg.loadError: Your campaign could not be loaded.
urpg.title: Tajuk
urpg.previewXP: {{xp}} XP at Done quality · active debuffs included
urpg.noItemsHelp: Create a meaningful next step, or adjust your filters.
urpg.completionHelp: This completion is recorded once. You can undo it from Reflection.
urpg.recoveryHelpShort: Choose a small reset to return to your rhythm.
urpg.debuffHelp: Debuffs affect future XP in one stat. Combined reductions are capped at 50%; existing XP stays intact.
urpg.encountersHelp: Keep a record of focus, recovery and distraction time.
urpg.rewardsEmpty: Add a reward you would enjoy working toward.
urpg.recoveryEmpty: No active debuffs. Keep a sustainable rhythm.
urpg.encountersEmpty: Log a focus session, a break, or a distraction to start your reflection.
urpg.vitalsHelp: Log what you eat and drink. Bars start fresh each day.
urpg.firstGainHelp: Tindakan pertama yang selesai akan memulakan kisah anda di sini.
